description: 4 Astro 1 Bio 1 Math is a team of high school students with a high enthusiasm for science, technology, and space exploration. By combining our interests across various disciplines— we collaborate to solve real-world challenges with creative perspectives. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are determined to hone our critical thinking skills, broaden our horizons, and gain valuable experience that will serve as a strong foundation for our academic journey and future in the world of science.
